name: Miss Thomas
mentions: The Marquise de Mores, Miss Thomas and Mr. and Mrs. Whitmore, of New York and Mr. Harck, of Germany, came in Friday night on the Marquis' car, Montana.
…e Marquis de Mores and Baron Von Hoffman left for St. Paul Sunday morning in the special car Livingston. Miss Thomas, who has been visiting at the Marquis', accompanied them.
